messages:
Emily: @priya looping you in — EdgeCloud asked for a joint POC kickoff. They want a shared architecture diagram, answers to their security questionnaire, and a rough dedicated-pricing ballpark. Can we sync?
Priya: happy to. do we have the questionnaire PDF yet? would like to pre-fill SAML/KMS/network answers.
Emily: Partner sent this afternoon, link: https://edgecloud.example/q/12345 (they pasted it into the thread). main asks: SSO via SAML, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency, and audit log retention.
Matt: for the joint arch: recommend Hosted API first + Dedicated reservation for test window. i can sketch a diagram — will include routing fallback to open-model variants if we hit capacity.
Priya: suggested minimal diagram: partner app -> partner VPC peering / VPC egress -> Redwood Private gateway (VPC) -> Dedicated pool (pinned model). include optional on-prem connector for their SOC.
Lisa: pricing note — for a 3-week co-sell POC we usually offer a trial Dedicated commit discount (50% off) + usage overage at our dev rate. need approvals for a custom quote if they want sustained capacity.
Emily: EdgeCloud asked whether we can sign a short addendum for the trial and a PO instead of invoicing monthly. legal will probably want the standard PO flow.
Priya: security Q specifics: 
- SAML: we support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. share ACS/metadata endpoints. 
- KMS: we support external key wrapping (bring-your-own-key) for Private deployments; Hosted requires request via entitlements. 
- Logs: audit logs are stored for 90 days by default; we can extend with the observability add-on.
Matt: config snippet for network peering we typically share:
```
peering:
  customer_vpc: vpc-abc
  redwood_private_endpoint: rp-<region>-1
  allowed_ports: [443]
  route_advertisement: disabled
```
Priya: re: data residency — for EU-only we can pin the Private control plane to eu-west region, but some telemetry flows (ops alerts) may route to US unless configured. that goes on the questionnaire.
Emily: EdgeCloud also flagged an enterprise blocker: they want SOC2 attestations + contract addendum for breach notification SLA. do we have template language?
Lisa: legal has a standard SOC2 + breach-notification clause. i'll pull the template and ping @legal. could take 48–72h.
Priya: for POC success criteria I suggest: 1) end-to-end inference latency < 200ms for 256 tokens, 2) stable throughput 50 req/s for 5m sustained, 3) successful SAML login and KMS unwrap key test. share these with EdgeCloud as acceptance tests.
Emily: perfect. can someone own the answers on the questionnaire? i'll own commercial/pricing. @Priya can you own technical answers + diagram? @Matt can you add the network snippet and on-prem notes?
Priya: i'll take technical + diagram. will draft and drop into this thread by EOD PST.
Matt: i'll add the network + ops notes and the canary rollout suggestion (canary on 10% traffic -> 50% -> full) by tomorrow morning.
deploy-bot: Reminder: upload of POC assets to partner-drive scheduled at 2024-06-05T17:00Z. :robot_face:
Emily: timeline: propose kickoff call with EdgeCloud on Friday 10am PT. Priya/Matt/Lisa please confirm availability. i'll book if yes.
Priya: confirmed.
Matt: confirmed.
Lisa: confirmed, i'll send calendar invite and include legal.
Emily: thanks team — aim to send the pre-filled questionnaire + arch diagram to partner by Thursday COB. will mark blockers here.
Priya: noted. I'll flag any open technical gaps once I start filling it out. :+1:
